subprocess: Don't add an extra whitespace at end of Windows command line

The windows code adds an unnecessary extra space to the command line.
This can cause subtle issues, so avoid it.

events.body:
> Can't this just go in with #32566? Why does it need it's own PR?

It would be easier to track backports.

The change is important for #32566 because the functional test was failing for the wallet notification, due to the extra space ending up in the output of `echo`.

i don't particularly mind how it ends up in the repository.
